description: This file defines the ShapeSerializer class responsible for serializing IShape objects to JSON within the OrchardCore.DisplayManagement.Shapes namespace.

classes.name: ShapeSerializer
classes.description: A class that serializes IShape objects to JSON, handling shape metadata, properties, classes, attributes, and nested shapes.

methods.name: ShapeSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with a specific IShape instance.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the associated IShape to a JsonObject, including nested shapes and properties.

methods.name: FindShapesInProperties
methods.description: Recursively finds and adds nested shapes within the properties of a shape.
